&api-questions;
The nbfx Diff API is the headless line comparison: Diff compares two texts line by line under DiffOptions and answers with a DiffResult, the Difference blocks of added, deleted and changed lines. It is the first part of the M-tier diff contract; Patch and Merge are planned for M2.
The comparison is the Hunt-McIlroy longest common subsequence, ported from the HuntDiff of NetBeans' diff module and kept package-private. The API is toolkit-free and knows nothing of files, version control or views: the lines come from wherever the caller has them, and what is done with the result is the caller's.
A diff view compares the content of a file at two points - the last commit, the index, the working tree - and draws the blocks that differ; a caller may leave out differences in case or in white space.
DiffTest covers additions, deletions and changes, their positions at the start and the end of a text, and the options. The API is under development until the MVP freeze, after which API signature tests (sigtest) are enabled.
